info.title: Traigent Agent-head Pinned Config Route
info.description: Exact pinned-version config read of the agent-head deploy target (TRAIG-101 plan 8.5). CARRIES CUSTOMER CONTENT: deliberately NOT a content-class lint root (explicit exception in scripts/content_class_lint.py EXPLICIT_CONTENT_EXCEPTIONS); outside the closed reactive contract and the Director bridge guarantee.

get.summary: Read the exact pinned config version of an agent head
get.description: Returns the spec of EXACTLY the version the head pins plus {generation, version} in one read; ETag = generation. Customer content (outside the closed reactive contract). Tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only (X-Tenant-Id, query strings and unknown body fields are never consulted or are refused). Dark behind PRODUCTION_REQUIREMENTS_ENABLED: while off the route answers the uniform unknown-route 404. Every error body is the closed envelope ../optimization/tvl_reactive_common_schema.json#/definitions/Refusal except 429.

401.description: unauthenticated. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

403.description: forbidden, fact_source_not_permitted. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

404.description: reference_not_found. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.

500.description: internal_error. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

503.description: service_unavailable. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.
